name: Sitemap Detection
description: Probes common sitemap locations at the site root, checks that the sitemap contains URLs and that robots.txt declares a Sitemap. Sitemaps let AI crawlers and search engines discover and refresh all pages rather than relying on link crawling.
inputs: GET {origin}/sitemap.xml, /sitemap_index.xml, /sitemap-index.xml, /sitemap1.xml (sequential, first response.ok wins, no timeout)

scoring.summary: Look for sitemap.xml, sitemap_index.xml, sitemap-index.xml, sitemap1.xml in the served root (in that order), then any sitemap declared by a robots.txt Sitemap: line that exists on disk. Else a sitemap generator in config (Astro @astrojs/sitemap with site, Hugo default, Next app/sitemap.*, next-sitemap, Eleventy sitemap templates, vite-plugin-sitemap, WordPress core) counts as found (predicted, URL count assumed > 0). None -> 0. Otherwise start at 5: -1 if robots.txt is absent, -2 if robots.txt has no Sitemap: directive (so an absent robots.txt costs 3), -2 if the sitemap has zero <loc> entries. A generated robots.txt is not penalized (inconclusive). Clamp at 0.

rules.condition: no sitemap file at the four probed names, none declared in robots.txt on disk, and no generator
no file but a generator is configured
no robots.txt in the served root and no robots.txt generator
robots.txt absent, or parseRobots(robots).sitemaps is empty (a real 'Sitemap:' directive; commented lines do not count)
count of /<loc[\s>]/ in the sitemap body == 0

rules.note: informational; child sitemaps are not read

scoring.status_mapping: Derived by the engine from the integer score: >= 80% pass, >= 50% warning, else fail; inconclusive results are always a warning. Scores: 5 pass, 3 warning, 2 or less fail.
scoring.inconclusive: When robots.txt is generated (not in the served root): the robots presence and reference penalties are skipped and inconclusive is true.

detect.source_procedure: 1) Probe the served root for sitemap.xml, sitemap_index.xml, sitemap-index.xml, sitemap1.xml, then robots.txt Sitemap: paths that exist on disk. 2) If none, detect a generator (lib/sources.mjs sitemapGenerator) -> predicted found. 3) If still none -> 0. 4) robots.txt absent -1; no Sitemap: directive -2 (skipped if robots.txt is generated). 5) Zero <loc> entries -2.
detect.llm_criteria: Model judges whether a generator config will actually emit a file at one of the four probed paths (e.g. Astro sitemap without site config, conditional Next.js sitemap routes, Hugo disableKinds) and whether the generated sitemap would contain at least one URL.

parity.note: Static files give full parity. Divergence: generated sitemaps depend on build config; hosting may add, rewrite or block routes (WAF/bot protection returning 403 makes the extension report no sitemap); a CMS or server may serve a sitemap not present in the repo; a SPA fallback that returns index.html with 200 for /sitemap.xml counts as "found" in the extension but with 0 <loc> (score 3 or lower); robots.txt may be generated by the host (e.g. Cloudflare managed robots.txt) and differ from the repo.

fix_summary: Add a sitemap at /sitemap.xml or /sitemap-index.xml (Astro @astrojs/sitemap plus site in astro.config, Hugo default sitemap, Next.js app/sitemap.ts, Eleventy sitemap template, public/sitemap.xml for Vite/static) and add "Sitemap: https://<domain>/sitemap.xml" to robots.txt (public/robots.txt, static/robots.txt, app/robots.ts). Requires knowing the production domain.

divergences.extension: Only the four fixed paths are probed; a sitemap declared in robots.txt at another path is 'not found' (fail 0).
divergences.plugin: A sitemap declared by a robots.txt Sitemap: line that exists in the served root also counts.
divergences.reason: Sitemap: in robots.txt is the standard discovery mechanism; the extension produced a false negative.

divergences.extension: robots.txt reference is lowercase includes('sitemap:'), which matches '# Sitemap:' comments or any text.
divergences.plugin: Only a real Sitemap: directive (lib/robots.mjs, comments stripped) counts.

divergences.extension: Live probes: 403/429/503/timeout on every path is fail 0 and an unreachable robots.txt costs 3.
divergences.plugin: Files are read from the served root; a sitemap generator without build output is predicted found; a generated robots.txt is not penalized (inconclusive).
divergences.reason: Source vs live and the unreachable-vs-absent rule.

divergences.plugin: Status derived from the integer score by the shared 80% / 50% rule (2/5 is fail).

divergences.extension: Reports whether the current page URL appears in the sitemap (informational).
divergences.reason: No current page in a site-level source audit; it never affected the score.
